## LC5简介：

 **LC5**
是国外一种很有名的密码破解软件，能破解用LM加密的SAM。可用它猜解2000\Xp\2003密码。它是著名的美国计算机安全公司Stake出品的Window/Unix密码查找软件LC5。

 **使用方法：**

 **1，在主机里新建用户名，密码陆续为空密码，与用户名相同密码，password123，分别进行登陆测试；**

（1）在运行里输入compmgmt.msc，点击确定

![1623067932_60be0d1c782f67b214b2e.png!small?1623067933493](https://image.3001.net/images/20210607/1623067932_60be0d1c782f67b214b2e.png!small?1623067933493)

打开了计算机管理窗口

![1623067962_60be0d3a2ee5d519fc5e1.png!small?1623067963241](https://image.3001.net/images/20210607/1623067962_60be0d3a2ee5d519fc5e1.png!small?1623067963241)

选择本地用户和组接着选择用户

![1623068003_60be0d630d36143dd7b81.png!small?1623068004038](https://image.3001.net/images/20210607/1623068003_60be0d630d36143dd7b81.png!small?1623068004038)

在下面的空白处点击右键，选择创建新用户即可

![1623068031_60be0d7f8f92bb80613e1.png!small?1623068032559](https://image.3001.net/images/20210607/1623068031_60be0d7f8f92bb80613e1.png!small?1623068032559)

点击创建一个空密码，点击后创建成功

![1623068058_60be0d9a9707fbee4af6b.png!small?1623068059553](https://image.3001.net/images/20210607/1623068058_60be0d9a9707fbee4af6b.png!small?1623068059553)

点击创建一个密码与用户名相同的，点击后创建成功

![1623068133_60be0de54a20fec8f5c58.png!small?1623068134404](https://image.3001.net/images/20210607/1623068133_60be0de54a20fec8f5c58.png!small?1623068134404)

点击创建一个密码为password123，点击后创建成功

![1623068162_60be0e02a91388480091c.png!small?1623068163688](https://image.3001.net/images/20210607/1623068162_60be0e02a91388480091c.png!small?1623068163688)

创建好的三个用户

![1623068277_60be0e75deeb54af52a8a.png!small?1623068278989](https://image.3001.net/images/20210607/1623068277_60be0e75deeb54af52a8a.png!small?1623068278989)

将3个用户都放入管理员组中，右键点击属性，

![1623068334_60be0eae2119bcab85132.png!small?1623068335527](https://image.3001.net/images/20210607/1623068334_60be0eae2119bcab85132.png!small?1623068335527)

点击确定

![1623068354_60be0ec266b21a6c0f1ac.png!small?1623068355329](https://image.3001.net/images/20210607/1623068354_60be0ec266b21a6c0f1ac.png!small?1623068355329)

将创建好的用户都重新登录一遍

![1623068392_60be0ee8a2e5ec70db613.png!small?1623068393762](https://image.3001.net/images/20210607/1623068392_60be0ee8a2e5ec70db613.png!small?1623068393762)

### 2，启动LC5，选择口令导入方式为从本地导入；

启动LC5

![1623068460_60be0f2c0e8842b6e4362.png!small?1623068461100](https://image.3001.net/images/20210607/1623068460_60be0f2c0e8842b6e4362.png!small?1623068461100)

选择从本地机器导入如图

![1623068479_60be0f3fa7a95ae3c1eca.png!small?1623068480848](https://image.3001.net/images/20210607/1623068479_60be0f3fa7a95ae3c1eca.png!small?1623068480848)

弹出【选择破解方法】。LC5提供了快速口令破解、普通口令破解、复杂口令破解以及自定义等如图：

我们选择快速破解口令

![1623068501_60be0f5542ff833e3a2ec.png!small?1623068502515](https://image.3001.net/images/20210607/1623068501_60be0f5542ff833e3a2ec.png!small?1623068502515)

然后全选下一步，最后完成。

![1623068523_60be0f6b64488aefc8600.png!small?1623068524380](https://image.3001.net/images/20210607/1623068523_60be0f6b64488aefc8600.png!small?1623068524380)

![1623068531_60be0f7392edc68b41c86.png!small?1623068532858](https://image.3001.net/images/20210607/1623068531_60be0f7392edc68b41c86.png!small?1623068532858)

点击文件，参数选择

![1623068579_60be0fa34a247559e1269.png!small?1623068580322](https://image.3001.net/images/20210607/1623068579_60be0fa34a247559e1269.png!small?1623068580322)

选择字典列表

![1623068603_60be0fbbda4b42398d3a3.png!small?1623068605035](https://image.3001.net/images/20210607/1623068603_60be0fbbda4b42398d3a3.png!small?1623068605035)

![1623068624_60be0fd07f4ee97f4c002.png!small?1623068625721](https://image.3001.net/images/20210607/1623068624_60be0fd07f4ee97f4c002.png!small?1623068625721)

重新选择向导

![1623068684_60be100c47f25bc604e96.png!small?1623068685211](https://image.3001.net/images/20210607/1623068684_60be100c47f25bc604e96.png!small?1623068685211)

这时我们选择口令快速破解

![1623068709_60be1025d6f24c5e9087a.png!small?1623068710980](https://image.3001.net/images/20210607/1623068709_60be1025d6f24c5e9087a.png!small?1623068710980)

结果：

![1623068825_60be1099b4cdaccd80019.png!small?1623068826714](https://image.3001.net/images/20210607/1623068825_60be1099b4cdaccd80019.png!small?1623068826714)

只破解了其中的前两个
